g.title: pr_update
g.text: Pull request update: the base branch is merged into the pull request's branch, as one merge commit

g.title: cluster_loop
g.text: Resolve and check (3 rounds at most)

g.title: start
g.text: A person comments /update on the ticket
or on the factory's pull request

g.title: rules
g.text: Is it the factory's own open pull request?
(on a ticket: find its pull request)

g.title: refuse
g.text: a short note: not the factory's · no pull request · closed

g.title: rules->refuse
g.text: no

g.title: merge
g.text: The controller merges the base branch
into the pull request's branch in its own clone
(git never runs in an agent's copy)

g.title: rules->merge
g.text: yes

g.title: state
g.text: what did the merge do?

g.title: uptodate
g.text: Nothing to merge: the branch already
has everything from the base

g.title: state->uptodate
g.text: already has the base

g.title: giveup
g.text: A person merges by hand: protected file in conflict,
more than 40 files, or a merge git cannot make

g.title: state->giveup
g.text: cannot be done
by the factory

g.title: resolver
g.text: merge-resolver, on a copy of the merged files
one answer per conflicted file; fixes what the merge broke

g.title: state->resolver
g.text: conflicts

g.title: checks
g.text: change checks + the project's checks
on the merged tree

g.title: state->checks
g.text: clean merge:
no agent needed

g.title: markers
g.text: every conflict answered once?
no conflict marker left? only allowed files changed?

g.title: markers->resolver
g.text: no: sent back with the reason

g.title: markers->checks
g.text: yes

g.title: checks->resolver
g.text: failed: output goes back

g.title: reviewers
g.text: reviewers look at what the agent wrote
(a merge git made alone needs none)

g.title: checks->reviewers
g.text: passed, agent wrote files

g.title: push
g.text: Push ONE merge commit with two parents
never forced; refused if someone pushed meanwhile

g.title: checks->push
g.text: passed, clean merge

g.title: ok
g.text: everything passes?

g.title: ok->resolver
g.text: no: feedback

g.title: ok->push
g.text: yes

g.title: wip
g.text: Nothing pushed to the pull request
work saved on a -wip branch + a comment

g.title: ok->wip
g.text: out of rounds
or blocked

g.title: reply
g.text: Reply: the merge commit, files that came in,
how each conflict was resolved, the checks

g.title: again
g.text: A person reviews and merges
(the factory never merges)
